data.name: Remake17
data.detailed_description:
"Remake17" is the second Galgame title produced by Entropy Link Tianchuang. In this game, you will take on the role of high school student Liang Yu, who travels back to the past following a car accident, and "re-encounters" and gets along with three female high school classmates: Ye Yunqing, Hua Lin, and Chen Shiran. However, beneath the seemingly tranquil surface of daily life, you discover that everyone is hiding their own secrets......

This work inherits the team's creative philosophy and style of staying close to real life, sets high school as the stage for the characters, adds a touch of suspense while centering on relaxed and humorous daily life, and attempts dual-line narrative and programming design that goes beyond traditional visual novels.

Synopsis

Liang Yu is twenty-seven years old this year.

At the age of seventeen, the vow I made with three female classmates that "we would meet again in ten years" is probably forgotten by everyone now.

After a car accident accompanied by a bizarre total solar eclipse, Liang Yu unexpectedly travels back to the day when he transferred to the new school.

Stepping back into the 11th-grade classroom, three pairs of eyes would shape his destiny: Ye Yunqing, the blonde mixed-race girl, a privileged young lady with hidden pain beneath her pride; Hua Lin, the reclusive painting prodigy with dyed red hair who spoke little; and Chen Shiran, the little sun who radiated warmth and light wherever she went.

At that point, he had not yet met them, nor had they met him. Everything seemed to be just beginning. ..

Yet behind this bright facade, certain gaps are gradually widening:

Figures that have long vanished from memory, entangled with family legacies, feuds, and past histories, are gradually coming to light. Fragments of memory keep reminding us: what's more, this might even be related to Liang Yu himself......

These once-overlooked stories make up the entirety of this tragedy. Now that everything has come to light, what path should one take? Will they be herded onto the same track by fate, or break free from their destined lot, or perhaps carry on this illusory perfection to the very end?

data.short_description: Remake17 is a galgame. You play as student Liang Yu, who travels back to high school ten years ago after an accident. Amid memory and reality, you'll find overlooked traces and the fates of three girls. Facing reality and illusion, regret and dreams, what will you choose?
